author: reek
body: The refusal half of the e1000 model, and the reason the model is in the catalog at all: a model that can only succeed is not a test of the driver that handles failure. Its `.vmargs` holds RST set forever, which is a part wedged in reset.

author: reek
body: Two things are asserted, and the second is the one with a history. The driver must report the device ABSENT rather than present, which it did not do until CL 12079: the fuel cap fired correctly after a million polls and the answer was discarded, so a part that never left reset came back as a healthy device with a valid address and a working ring pair.

author: reek
body: init-cost answers a pair the only way a chapter with no tuples can: the caller asks twice, and the device is brought up once per question. That is deliberate, because two bring-ups of a wedged part must both refuse.
